source_caption:
Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood follows Ashtray, a young man who moves back to South Central Los Angeles to live with his father and cousin Loc Dog. As he tries to navigate family, friendships, neighborhood life, and growing up, he gets pulled into a series of ridiculous situations.

In Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood, the film is a spoof comedy that parodies 1990s hood and coming-of-age movies, especially films such as Boyz n the Hood and Menace II Society. Directed by Paris Barclay, it stars Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, and Keenen Ivory Wayans.
